executive_summary: Dexterous and deformable-object manipulation see major advances, from grounding generated video plans in simulation to real-robot benchmarks and full-shape estimation under partial observability.

New frameworks for VLM/VLA-driven manipulation and generalist policies (GTA-2, DUET-DINO, FreqFM, TFGCA, HaWMPO, RoboDrop, JEPA Policy) significantly boost zero-shot skill synthesis, long-horizon planning, and data efficiency.
Motion planning and navigation progress spans AGV traffic management and routing, continuum-robot diffusion planners, symmetry-aware learned planners, and high-rate MPC for tiny drones.

Whole-body control and locomotion are pushed to more challenging regimes, including humanoid brachiation, granular terrain walking, perceptive visual loco-manipulation, and legged curricula via actuator dynamics.

Safety, robustness, and partial observability are addressed via belief-state planning for LLM agents, STL-based corrective control, risk-sensitive driving, odometry drift correction, and adaptive shared control.
Benchmarks and systems work (FolDeX, RealSimLoop, InstantMimic, Bayesian optimization survey) emphasize standardized evaluation, real-to-sim adaptation, and massively accelerated policy training.

institution_matches.title: Grounding Generated Video Plans in Simulation Towards Versatile Dexterous Controllers
institution_matches.overview: Introduces a pipeline that converts generated hand–object interaction videos into executable dexterous manipulation controllers by grounding them in simulation. A multi-object, multi-trajectory HOI tracker trained on over 1,500 grounded videos substantially outperforms baselines and transfers to real robots for diverse grasps and non-prehensile manipulation.

institution_matches.title: GTA-2: A Multi-VLM Framework for Synthesizing Robot Manipulation Skills via Grounded Task Axes
institution_matches.overview: Presents GTA-2, a modular multi-VLM system that composes object-centric task axes into executable, task-specific manipulation skills without task-specific demos or policy training. Four specialized VLM agents decompose tasks, assemble axis-based skills, assign controller parameters, and ground visual features, achieving strong zero-shot and refined performance on 14 real-robot tasks.

topic_matches.title: FolDeX: A Physical-World Benchmark for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation of Deformable Objects
topic_matches.overview: Defines FolDeX, a large-scale real-robot benchmark centered on garment folding to study long-horizon deformable-object manipulation and heterogeneous real-world data reuse. The suite spans 2,000+ hours, 20+ tasks, and 10+ embodiments, with a standardized remote evaluation platform to fairly compare policies under realistic variations.

topic_matches.title: Deformable Object Manipulation under Partial Observability via Real-Time Full-Shape Estimation
topic_matches.overview: Proposes cRVAE, a conditional recurrent VAE that reconstructs full deformable-object state from sparse corner-node observations and runs fast enough for receding-horizon control. In rope and fabric tasks, it matches XPBD accuracy while being orders of magnitude faster, enabling obstacle-aware collaborative manipulation on a Unitree Go2 robot.

topic_matches.title: Assembling Two Parts in One Hand
topic_matches.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology; The University of Hong Kong; University of Hong Kong ffiliation:
topic_matches.overview: Formulates in-hand assembly of two rigid objects with a single dexterous hand as an RL problem driven by a goal relative pose between parts. Auxiliary rewards, human-inspired pose regularization, and robust sensing enable a single recipe to solve multiple assembly tasks in simulation with zero-shot transfer to hardware using only one camera.

topic_matches.title: DUET-DINO: Simultaneous Cross-View World Modeling for Latent Planning in Robot Manipulation
topic_matches.overview: Introduces DUET-DINO, a cross-view latent world model that jointly predicts action-conditioned futures from side and wrist cameras for full 7-DoF end-effector planning. Leveraging complementary views and DINOv3 features, it improves zero-shot planning on diverse manipulation tasks and is robust to visual distribution shifts.

topic_matches.title: A traffic management system for large and heterogeneous vehicles in narrow industrial environments
topic_matches.overview: Develops an AGV traffic management system based on lifelong multi-agent path finding over NURBS roadmaps, tailored to dense, non-grid industrial layouts. A bounded-horizon CBS variant with rolling conflict resolution and deadlock handling boosts throughput by up to 11% over rule-based and industrial baselines while ensuring safe coordination.

topic_matches.title: HiRAD: A Flexible Large-Scale AGV Routing System
topic_matches.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
topic_matches.overview: Proposes HiRAD, a hierarchical RL framework for continuous-space routing of large AGV fleets with real-time guarantees. It decomposes heading and speed, uses a step-level spatiotemporal representation, and an event-driven decision pipeline to cut inference complexity and reduces makespan by up to 63% on warehouses and random graphs.

topic_matches.title: PccDiffuser: Multi-solution Motion Planning for Continuum Robots
topic_matches.overview: Introduces PccDiffuser, a conditional diffusion model that learns a multimodal distribution over configuration-space paths for continuum robots under a constant-curvature model. With GNN-based obstacle encoding and analytic differential kinematics in the denoiser, it achieves 91% success and efficient multi-solution planning, validated on a tendon-driven continuum robot.

topic_matches.title: What Symmetry Buys a Learned Motion Planner
topic_matches.overview: Shows that expressing planning problems in a start–goal frame analytically removes most SE(3) symmetries, dramatically improving learned motion-planner performance without architectural changes. On cluttered 3D benchmarks, this representation alone raises collision-free success from 14.6% to 51.1%, dwarfing gains from enforcing residual equivariance in the model.

topic_matches.title: AccelMPC: High-Rate, Low-Power FPGA-Accelerated Model Predictive Control for Tiny Drones
topic_matches.overview: Presents AccelMPC, an FPGA-accelerated ADMM-based MPC solver co-designed with a lightweight PCB for 35 g drones, enabling 1 kHz onboard constrained control with dynamic obstacles. The system achieves up to 15.6× faster solves and nearly 200× better energy–delay product than microcontroller baselines while scaling to very large optimization problems.

topic_matches.title: SwingBot: Learning Whole-Body Brachiation for Humanoid Robots
topic_matches.overview: Develops SwingBot, a learning framework that enables humanoid robots with passive hooks to perform continuous brachiation on overhead bars. By using biomimetic keyframes and recurrent privileged state estimation, it learns long-horizon release–swing–capture sequences that robustly traverse varying bar spacings and external disturbances in hardware.
